The debug views of `viewport.capture` at engine `319075e3f92b`: the values of its `debugView` parameter. &quot;streaming&quot; tints entities by streaming state (pending Sulfur, failed Cinnabar, missing meshes as boxes), &quot;lod&quot; by level of detail, &quot;mip&quot; by the mip levels their textures lack, &quot;motion&quot; colors pixels by their motion since the capture's previous frame (rendered twice for it: still scenes show none), &quot;shadows&quot; colors receivers by screen pixels per shadow texel and outlines the cascades; &quot;lighting&quot; white surfaces, &quot;ao&quot; ambient occlusion, &quot;indirect&quot; indirect light only, &quot;luminance&quot; EV100 bands, &quot;albedo&quot; base colors (outside 0.03-0.85 marked), each with debugView.lighting: {view, surfaceShare, surfaceEv100 {p05, p50, p95}, backgroundEv100, value {median, p05} (ao, albedo), belowRangeShare, aboveRangeShare (albedo), sunIlluminance, skyIlluminance (lux on flat ground), sunToSkyRatio}; &quot;voxels&quot; the GI's voxels, with debugView.globalIllumination {ran, settled, voxelLevels, memoryMiB}; &quot;specular&quot; and &quot;diffuse&quot; the light of one kind (no emission, no fog), &quot;clusters&quot; the lights each pixel's light cluster lists as bands (none, 1, 2-3, 4-7, ...; debugView.lighting.value: shares of a cluster's capacity); &quot;culled&quot; boxes of the mesh renderers in view that culling left out (too small: Sulfur, about 6 pixels across; hidden behind what is drawn: Cinnabar, the GPU-driven path's occlusion culling; renderStats.sizeCulledProxies counts the first, occludedProxies all found hidden, also those the frame drew once more while the camera moves), &quot;wireframe&quot; the edges of every triangle drawn over the image (it needs the device's non-solid fill mode: without it the lines are left out and the log says why); &quot;none&quot; not at all (default: the viewport's debug view)
